name: Book of Artisans: a profession rank the character's skill already reached reads known
contract: A trainer rank row (Journeyman/Expert/Artisan Woodworker 1005015-1005017) teaches a rank spell (1005009-1005011) whose SPELL_EFFECT_SKILL grants a skill maximum of step x 75 (150, 225, 300). Trainer::GetSpellState read a row as known only when the character had that exact rank spell, so a character whose Woodworking is already 300/300 without those spells - raised by another route, such as the Tradesman's Scroll, which only teaches ranks above the current step - kept being offered all three ranks as available. A rank whose granted maximum the character's pure maximum already reaches is now known. Expected: with Woodworking 300/300 and only the apprentice spell, the three Woodworker ranks read known (2); with Tailoring 60/75, Journeyman Tailor (maximum 150) is still available (0).

steps.label: Woodworking maxed without its rank spells
Journeyman Woodworking is not a learned spell
Journeyman Tailor is still available at a maximum of 75
